create_unique_labels: create an ordered array of unique labels from multiple target arrays, validating compatible label types
test_type_of_target: test an array to determine its target type such as binary, multiclass, continuous, or multilabel-indicator
check_classification_target: check that a target array is of a non-regression type and warn if class count exceeds 50% of samples
compute_class_distribution: compute class priors from a multioutput-multiclass target matrix with optional sample weights
build_ovr_decision_function: build a continuous tie-breaking one-vs-rest decision function from one-vs-one predictions and confidences
